title: Only the 150 KiB JS rule is encoded: nothing measures the 1 MiB first-load rule, the lazy reader/editor chunks, or LCP/CLS at a fixed profile, and lighthouserc.cjs has no stated assertions (@lhci/cli is not even a dependency)
why_needed: VERIFICATION.md:55 keeps 'Initial HTML+CSS+fonts+hero <1MiB', 'Lazy PDF/editor/board chunks measured separately' and 'LCP<2.5s, CLS<0.1'; WORK-PACKAGES.md:127/131 list lighthouserc.cjs and 'public initial budget measured' for P10 without saying which pages, which throttling profile or how many runs. Measured today on the export: HTML+CSS+fonts+LCP image is 255-548 KB per page at 360 (/book the largest; fonts, 234-391 KB, are the largest part), so the 1 MiB rule holds but nothing would catch a regression; opening the book costs about 850 KiB compressed (pdf.js 125.8 KiB gz, worker 367 KiB gz, reader and page-flip 21 KiB, the PDF 339 KiB) and is measured nowhere; LCP at 360 with DevTools slow 4G and 4x CPU is above 2.5 s on 10 of the 19 public pages measured, 3.3-5.6 s on 7 of them (m-mob.json), so the gate needs a defined profile to be judged at all.
touches: scripts/check-budgets.mjs (or a Playwright perf script), lighthouserc.cjs, package.json (@lhci/cli), .github/workflows/ci.yml, PLANS/VERIFICATION.md

title: check:export does not check that the export's own references resolve, so a hosted build without the git-ignored films (I33) or a missing image derivative passes
why_needed: check-export.mjs checks required pages, secrets and demo text only. refs.mjs over today's export: 297 same-origin URLs referenced by the HTML (src, srcset, poster, the RSC payload) and CSS, all present locally only because public/media/*.mp4 sit on this machine; .gitignore:38 excludes them, so a Pages build from Git ships pages whose 18 films 404 (I33) and the check stays green. A small existence check over the HTML/CSS references turns I33 and any future missing derivative into a failed deploy instead of a silent 404.
